Information for Tenderer/Consultant :
Eligibility of Tenderer : -The minimum number of years of general experience of the Tenderer in the construction works as Prime Contractor or
Subcontractor or Management Contractor shall be 10 years.
-The minimum specific experience as a Prime Contractor in construction works of at least 01 (One) Contract of similar nature of
building having RCC frame Structure with 2 Basement of minimum 8 Storied height successfully completed within the last 05
years, with a value of at least Tk. 2500 Lacs in any government, semi government & autonomous body of Bangladesh
-The required average annual construction turnover shall be greater than Tk. 27.00 Corers over the best 3 years in the last 05
years.
As an evidence of average annual construction turnover, The Tenderer shall submit attested copies of work order(s), Certificate(s)
regarding successful completion of the work(s), Payment certificate(s) and Bank statement(s) of the Concerned years.
-The minimum amount of liquid assets i.e working capital or credit line(s) of the Tenderers shall be Tk. 570 lacs.
- The PPR- 2008 and its amendment will be followed by both the department and the tenderers.
- Submit attested photocopy of Enlistment Certificate as minimum Class-I Building Construction Contractor in any Government,
Semi-Government & Autonomous body which is renewed upto 30th June 2016 and up to date A,B,C class license from electric
licensing board.
Brief Description of Works : Construction of Cast in situ pile, Mat foundation, two nos of under ground basement, super structure, installation of lift, installation
of escalator, installation of substation, installation of generator, deep tube well, sanitary and plumbing work, Internal electrification
works etc.
